subject: Build freeze causing demo delay — request for additional trial credits & extension
messages:
From: Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@greenline.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: platform@greenline.ai
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood POC timeline — build freeze on our side

Jordan —

Quick update from our infra team: we hit an unexpected blocker in our internal CI that manifested yesterday during a schema rollout. The result is a full build freeze for the next 5 business days while we validate migration scripts.

This obviously pushes our demo timeline and the trial consumption we planned for the week of May 10th. We’re still invested in Redwood and want to keep momentum, but we’ll need more runway on the sandbox and a small credits top-up so our QA team can run the full eval once the freeze is lifted.

Can you advise on whether Redwood can extend the trial window by 10 days and add ~$2k in sandbox credits? We’re aiming to demo to the execs the week of May 24th — any help there keeps this deal live.

Thanks,
Alex Monroe
Principal Product Manager
Greenline Analytics

[Attachment: infra_build_log.txt (text/plain)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@greenline.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood POC timeline — build freeze on our side

Alex —

Really appreciate the heads up and thanks for the build log, that’s helpful. I’m sorry to hear about the freeze. We can absolutely support an extension and a modest top-up — happy to propose an immediate path to keep your trial healthy.

Proposed options:
- Option A: 14-day trial extension + $2,000 sandbox credits (exec approval via me)
- Option B: 10-day trial extension + $3,000 credits if you want to expand parallel QA runs

Operational ask: can you confirm the earliest date your CI team expects to be unblocked? Karthik and Soojin are cc’d so we can scope any follow-up technical triage if you want an eng handshake while you unblock.

If you confirm Option A I’ll route for approval and push the credits + extension within 24 hours.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0189

[Attachment: mutual-action-plan-v3.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@greenline.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood POC timeline — build freeze on our side

Alex —

Thanks for sharing the log. Quick engineering note: if your CI rollout is blocking builds for schema migrations we can set up a short environment that mirrors your production deploy path but slices the schema step out so QA can exercise model integrations earlier (proxy approach). That would reduce the need for a larger credits spend while you’re blocked.

If you want us to stand up the slice environment we’ll need:
- a short window to copy the current staging DB schema (read-only)
- pointer to the service account you want us to use (or we can use a scoped token)
- expected date when you want the full run (so we can hold the environment live — typically 72 hours)

We can also prioritize a BizOps fast-track approval if Jordan confirms the credit/extension package. Happy to hop on a 20-min call with your platform lead if that helps.

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-05-04T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood POC timeline — build freeze on our side

Alex —

Thanks for the quick responses and for confirming the CI window earlier today. Per our side: I’ve signed off on Option A (14-day extension + $2,000 sandbox credit). BizOps will apply the extension and the credits by end of day tomorrow.

Karthik — thanks for the workaround suggestion; Alex, if you’re open to the proxy environment we can scope that as a short-term lift (no longer than 72 hours) once your staging schema snapshot is available. That will let QA run the full integration tests before your exec demo and reduce risk of rework.

Next steps:
- Jordan to confirm extension/credits applied by EOD 2027-05-05
- Alex to share service account pointer or confirm Redwood can use a scoped token (reply here)
- Karthik to prepare the proxy environment checklist once token/schema is available

Appreciate your flexibility — we’ll do what we can to keep Greenline’s exec demo on track.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
